name: memail_get
description: Get one message in full by `id` (a UUID from memail_list / memail_search / memail_thread). Returns the message with from/to/cc, subject, both body_text and body_html, sent_at/received_at, is_unread, thread_id, and `attachments` — a list of { id, filename, content_type, size_bytes, downloadable }. Note: attachment metadata is available but the bytes are NOT retrievable in this version (downloadable is false), so describe attachments by name/type/size; you cannot open or read their contents.
